newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Haixin to issue rights shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Haixin to issue rights shares.

text.p: Textile maker, Shanghai Haixin Co said on Friday it would issue 2.5-for-10 rights shares at a price of 4.5 yuan each for all shareholders.

Foreign currency B share holders can buy the rights shares at $0.543 per share, based on an exchange rate of 8.2912 yuan to the U.S. dollar, the company said in a statement published in the Shanghai Securities News.
The deadline for B share holders to pay for the rights shares is August 8 and domestic A share holders must pay before August 1, the statement said.
The company's B shares closed at $0.56 on Thursday and its domestic A shares ended at 17.88 yuan.

The issue, if fully subscribed, will raise a net income of 182 million yuan, excluding the issue cost, and proceeds will mainly be used to upgrade the company's production technology, the statement said.
The rights shares will be listed on the Shanghai stock exchange after the issue at a date yet to be set, it said.
